items.title: How Apple stock usually reacts to big iPhone reveal events
How Apple's stock is performing ahead of a pivotal product launch
items.summary: AllSource Investment Management founder and Managing Partner Patrick Kennedy and Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Apple's (AAPL) stock performance one day before CEO John Ternus hosts his first iPhone event as head of the company, where he is expected to unveil a $2,000 foldable iPhone.

items.title: Amgen, Novartis, Qualcomn, Corning, Lumentum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.  Investor attention may turn to  Apple  on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.  Artificial-intelligence stocks were advancing despite the market’s inflation worries.
